_comment: Map each Slack member ID (profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID) to the traveller's details exactly as on their government ID. Rename this file to travellers.json.
_fields: given_name, family_name, email are required to search. date_of_birth (YYYY-MM-DD), gender (male/female), nationality and passport_country (2-letter ISO code, e.g. IN), passport_number and passport_expiry (YYYY-MM-DD) are required to book via the LetsFG REST API; passport_issue is optional. Leave them null: each traveller is asked for them privately in Slack and they are stored encrypted. Only fill them here from the traveller's real passport — never placeholder values. This file is kept owner-readable only (chmod 600).
